craft_notes: Sthāyin: fancy-ash (man-ness left). Rows: row 1 (fancy-burned whole). Close: supreme (paramo — adjective-final, matches Sanskrit). Rejected: 'ego-death' again — killed: man-ness kept (pumbhāva); 'in the mind of man' cramped — kept non-other mind.

lines: Thus world all burnt, fancy burned through:
in non-other mind of man — man-ness supreme.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam eva jagat sarvaṃ dagdhaṃ dhyātvā vikalpataḥ | ananyacetasaḥ puṃsaḥ pumbhāvaḥ paramo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What remains after burning? → Fancy-burned world leaves only man-ness supreme in the non-other mind.
c1_essence: Fancy-burned world leaves only man-ness in the non-other mind.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta undertow (stillness with the burnt-world wonder)
